env_files.role: Archived baseline brief containing superseded launch assumptions; context only

Operational workbook with approval-backed state changes, code-candidate fallback chains, current/previous corrected telemetry, policy and issue change comparison, stage extensions, checkpoint register, business calendar, package manifests, and support routes
Authoritative current/previous checkpoint resolution, catalog fallback, corrected weighted aggregation, change classification, package arithmetic, multi-gate stage, and business-calendar rules

source_policy.resolution: independent current/previous checkpoint reconciliation with approval quorum, catalog fallback, corrected weighted telemetry, policy and issue change comparison, package arithmetic, multi-gate stage evaluation, and business-calendar checkpoint calculation

design_notes: Newest approved code changes are not automatically current; catalog validation and checkpoint resolution can force fallback for build, copy, policy, issue pack, support route, and stage.
Worldwide automatic coverage must be weighted from five corrected regional count pairs rather than averaged or taken from a single raw telemetry row.
Five active non-general qualifications must be resolved with exact cohort, region, decision or end timing, and fallback, then compared against the previous public checkpoint.
Package sizes are derived from validated manifest components using decimal-megabyte ceiling and must be separated into full installer and update payload, including the smaller-than percentage.
The selected issue pack contains three current issues plus checkpoint-to-checkpoint issue-state changes; draft no-issue copy is invalid.
Grounded VQAs were rebalanced into smaller, less over-bundled checks while preserving image_vqa_0_2 mode, 0.8/0.2 dimension weights, and the original visual-quality VQA.
